_anglais: Who the hell is this guy? Where are we?
Dude, it's just an apero.
No way, this isn’t an apero.
Watch it, buddy—I’ve got a short fuse.
Where the hell are we?
I got no clue what you’re talking about.
How am I supposed to explain this?
Where’s the beer, the schnapps, the gin, the pastis?
Oh no, this is alcohol-free.
What the...?
It’s a concept. Aperos without alcohol.
A *concept*?
Yeah.
You wanna die, Sébastien?
Just today, you mean.
If your ‘concept’ is crap, I’ll grab it, twist it, and shove it up your ass.
Exactly. What do you think?
Come on, get the lamb, the porcini—fast, I’m about to lose it, this is gonna be a massacre.
What the hell is *this*? Black radish with beet juice?
Radish is red, Sébastien.
I know, this one’s a special variant. Fits the alcohol-free concept.
Look, I’m trying real hard to stay calm here.
I can tell you’re not buying it.
Me?
Oh yeah, I *love* beet juice with radishes that look like dried-up shit.
It’s black radish, you cut it in slices. Listen, if you pull out a beer right now, I’ll forget all this and we’ll start fresh.
Otherwise, I know myself—I’m gonna snap, it’s gonna be a bloodbath.
No, but...
No, no, no—look, I’d rather be straight with you. You’re running out of time.
So pull out that beer before this shitshow escalates and you’re left in the dust.
I don’t have any. There’s not a drop of alcohol in this place.
It’s an alcohol-free apero.
Stop calling it an apero, I swear I’ll gut you.
Oh wait, I do!
Oh, a *panaché*—that’ll do the trick.
Don’t say that, Sébastien.
What, *what*? Run, Sébastien!
Run *far* away.
For our friendship’s sake, I’ll give you a head start—but *run* fast.
No, but...
Wait, I’ll pour it *on* you.
I’ll shove it up your ass.
